name: Ephesus
christ: He that holdeth the seven stars in his right hand and walketh in the midst of the seven golden candlesticks
commendation: Works, labour and patience; cannot bear evil men; tested false apostles and found them liars; hates the deeds of the Nicolaitans
rebuke: Thou hast left thy first love
exhortation: Remember from whence thou art fallen, repent and do the first works, or the candlestick will be removed
promise: To eat of the tree of life in the midst of the paradise of God

name: Smyrna
christ: The first and the last, which was dead, and is alive
commendation: Works, tribulation and poverty (yet rich); enduring the blasphemy of the synagogue of Satan
exhortation: Fear none of the coming suffering (prison, tribulation ten days); be faithful unto death
promise: A crown of life; shall not be hurt of the second death

name: Pergamos
christ: He which hath the sharp sword with two edges
commendation: Holds fast Christ's name and did not deny the faith, even where Satan's seat is, in the days of Antipas the faithful martyr
rebuke: Some hold the doctrine of Balaam (eating things sacrificed to idols, fornication) and of the Nicolaitans
exhortation: Repent, or Christ will come quickly and fight against them with the sword of his mouth
promise: Hidden manna and a white stone with a new name written on it

name: Thyatira
christ: The Son of God, with eyes like a flame of fire and feet like fine brass
commendation: Charity, service, faith and patience; the last works more than the first
rebuke: Tolerates the woman Jezebel, a self-styled prophetess who seduces servants to fornication and idol sacrifices
exhortation: The rest who have not known the depths of Satan: hold fast what ye have till Christ comes
promise: Power over the nations, to rule them with a rod of iron; the morning star

name: Sardis
christ: He that hath the seven Spirits of God and the seven stars
commendation: A few names which have not defiled their garments; they shall walk with Christ in white
rebuke: A name that thou livest, and art dead; works not found perfect before God
exhortation: Be watchful, strengthen the things that remain, remember, hold fast and repent, or Christ will come as a thief
promise: Clothed in white raiment; name not blotted out of the book of life but confessed before the Father and his angels
modern: Sart, near Salihli, Manisa Province, Turkey

name: Philadelphia
christ: He that is holy and true, that hath the key of David, that openeth and no man shutteth
commendation: With little strength has kept Christ's word and not denied his name; kept the word of his patience; an open door set before it
exhortation: Hold that fast which thou hast, that no man take thy crown
promise: Kept from the hour of temptation; made a pillar in the temple of God, bearing the name of God, of New Jerusalem, and Christ's new name

name: Laodicea
christ: The Amen, the faithful and true witness, the beginning of the creation of God
rebuke: Lukewarm, neither cold nor hot; says "I am rich" yet is wretched, miserable, poor, blind and naked
exhortation: Buy of Christ gold tried in the fire, white raiment and eyesalve; be zealous and repent; open the door to him who knocks
promise: To sit with Christ in his throne, as he sat down with his Father in his throne
